fields.proposed_value: Scope session with the VP of Admissions and the CIO. Lumen wants 120 users across admissions, marketing and leadership, integrations with Campus One, Mailwave and WhatsApp, and student data kept in Brazil. The approved budget is USD 110-130k per year and go-live is needed by May 2027. Daniela asked for a proposal; a review was agreed for 17 Nov.
